description: Pittston, PA – Rep. Rob Bresnahan today announced the launch of the “Women for Rob” Coalition, a growing network of more than 80 women across all five counties in the 8th Congressional District supporting his re-election campaign and his record of delivering results for Northeastern Pennsylvania families. The coalition will be co-chaired by Monroe County Republican Women Chair and Republican State Committee Member Shelli Bird and Mayfield Borough Council President Diana Campbell.
paid_for_by: Paid for by Rob for PA
title: Rob Bresnahan Announces Launch of “Women for Rob” Coalition - Rob for PA
